answer: Random mutual audit keeps the wharf honest. Agents docking there stake 25 units for one ivory audit ticket, by lottery. Each epoch the beacon pairs agents to audit each other: catching a clone farm earns half the slashed stake, while a lazy one loses ticket and deposit. A tide of 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 tickets and 25,000 units, yet the pool pays only 40, so cloning loses. Honest agents stake 25 once and earn audit fees instead of being diluted.
